name: Text Renderer
description: Static utility class for measuring and rendering text on HTML Canvas using @chenglou/pretext for segment-level Unicode-aware text layout. Provides measure() for height calculation, draw() for direct context rendering, createCanvas() for single-style text canvases, and createCanvas2() for multi-style text with variable line heights. Handles DPR scaling for sharp rendering.

types.name: TextStyle
types.definition: { font: string; color: string; lineHeight?: number }

static_methods.name: measure
static_methods.signature: (text: string, font: string, maxWidth: number) => number

static_methods.name: draw
static_methods.signature: (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, text: string, x: number, y: number, maxWidth: number, style: TextStyle) => void
static_methods.description: Draw text onto canvas context with given style

static_methods.name: createCanvas
static_methods.signature: (text: string, width: number, height: number, style: TextStyle) => HTMLCanvasElement
static_methods.description: Create DPR-scaled canvas with single-style text

static_methods.name: createCanvas2
static_methods.signature: (lines: { text: string; style: TextStyle }[], width: number, height: number) => HTMLCanvasElement
static_methods.description: Create DPR-scaled canvas with multi-style text, each line with its own style
